# Veridell

> Veridell turns a question into an answer taken from a published encyclopaedia
> entry, with the source attached. Ask in your own words in Hindi or English and
> get the answer, its key points, the topics the entry covers, and a link to the
> original page. The article breakdown is quoted from the source; the optional
> chat mode can add an AI explanation that is restricted to the selected source
> passages and marked with numbered citations.

Veridell has two reading modes. The **article breakdown** is extractive: every
sentence is a sentence from the source, selected and ordered, so the answer can
be checked against the page it came from. **Chat** is assisted: an AI model is
prompted with the question and a handful of source excerpts and is instructed to
answer only from them, citing the passage number for each claim.

## Where the data goes

- Search, article and Wikidata requests go from the visitor's browser to the
  public Wikimedia APIs. Those APIs need no key.
- When chat AI is used, the question and the selected source excerpts are sent
  to the same-origin `/api/ask` Cloudflare Pages Function, which calls the
  configured OpenRouter model or the Cloudflare Workers AI binding. Provider
  credentials are server-side only.
- There is no account. Bookmarks, reading history and saved chat answers stay in
  the visitor's own browser storage.

## What this site is for

- A reader who wants an answer rather than a list of links.
- A reader who wants to check the answer against the page it came from.
- A reader working in Hindi or English, or in any of the twelve language
  editions the search offers.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://veridell.pages.dev/): ask a question, or open a breakdown.
- [Chat](https://veridell.pages.dev/chat/): ask in your own words, with
  Quick / Detailed / Deep answers, saved answers, voice input and read-aloud.
- [Articles](https://veridell.pages.dev/articles/): the published entries, as
  static pages that read without JavaScript.
- [Topics](https://veridell.pages.dev/topics/): the entries grouped by subject.
- [Questions](https://veridell.pages.dev/questions/): questions this site can
  answer, written out in full.
- [How it works](https://veridell.pages.dev/how-it-works/): where the text comes
  from, and what is and is not generated.
- [Help](https://veridell.pages.dev/help/): how to use the site.
- [Research Desk](https://veridell.pages.dev/research/): search, inspect and
  compare sources directly.

## How to cite an answer from this site

Quote the entry, not this site, and link the original page shown under each
answer. Article text is available under CC BY-SA 4.0 from the Wikimedia
projects; Veridell is an independent reader and is not affiliated with or
endorsed by the Wikimedia Foundation. An AI explanation is a reading aid, not a
source: cite the passage it points to.

## Notes for automated readers

- Every entry page is static HTML and readable without JavaScript.
- `sitemap.xml` lists every crawlable page with its last-modified date.
- `robots.txt` allows all crawlers and points at the sitemap.
- The interactive answer chat needs JavaScript; the entries do not.
